Subject: Orbit POC — request for hands-on session and capacity details

Hi Karthik —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We’re ready to move to a hands-on POC with a small working group (2 engineers, 1 product). Before we lock calendar time, could you confirm:

- Recommended duration for an interactive session that includes prompt review, routing checks, and a short ramped load test (we planned ~90m).
- Whether we should run this on your Hosted tier or request Dedicated trial capacity for the initial load test.
- Typical quota bump timeline and any token budget guardrails to avoid surprises.

We’re aiming for the week of Jun 19; Samantha + one engineer are flexible afternoons PT. I attached a short list of prompts we want to try.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick 15m if that helps sync.

—Sam
Samantha Wu
Head of Integrations, Orbit Labs
attachments: orbit-poc-prompts.txt
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Wu <samantha@orbitlabs.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Jun 2028 09:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Orbit POC — request for hands-on session and capacity details

Hi Sam — great to hear you’re ready to run the hands-on. Short answers up front: 90 minutes is ideal for prompt review + routing checks + a light load test.

Hosted vs Dedicated: for the initial ramped load test (>100 concurrent small chats or long-generation bursts) we recommend Dedicated trial capacity so you can validate throughput without noisy neighbors. If you want to stick to Hosted for speed, we can do a smaller test but token limits can impact concurrency.

Quota bumps: we can provision a temporary quota bump for the Dedicated trial within 24–48 hours once the purchase order / trial request is in. Token budgets: we ask customers to provide an expected sample mix (short chat vs long generation); I attached a token-budget template.

I’ve looped in Grace (CS lead) and Diego (runtime PM) to coordinate the technical agenda and loadtest plan. Proposed next steps:
- Grace: propose two 90m slots (Jun 20 afternoon PT, Jun 21 morning PT)
- Diego: review the attached load test plan and confirm infrastructure needs
- Sam: confirm preferred slot + whether you want Dedicated trial (we’ll initiate the paperwork)

I’ll follow with an agenda and a Calendly link.

Thanks,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
attachments: orbit-token-budget.csv
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Wu <samantha@orbitlabs.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Jun 2028 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Orbit POC — request for hands-on session and capacity details

Hi Sam —

Thanks Karthik. Sam, two candidate 90m slots:
- Tue Jun 20, 14:00–15:30 PT
- Wed Jun 21, 09:00–10:30 PT

Agenda (draft):
1) 15m introductions & goals alignment
2) 25m prompt review and expected outputs (Samantha + engineer)
3) 30m routing & streaming walkthrough (Redwood demo)
4) 15–20m ramped load test (observability + cost/latency checks)
5) 10m next steps (dedicated trial paperwork / token budget follow-up)

Diego — can you review the load test file and confirm we can run the ramp to 120 concurrent short-chat sessions in Dedicated? If Dedicated isn’t ready by the session we’ll run a scaled test on Hosted and follow up with a Dedicated run once provisioned.

Sam — would you prefer Dedicated for the first run? If yes I’ll kick off the trial request and share the procurement checklist (PO + signed MSA).

Best,
Grace
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
attachments: orbit-poc-agenda.pdf
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Wu <samantha@orbitlabs.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Orbit POC — request for hands-on session and capacity details

Grace / Karthik — quick infra readout: Dedicated trial can support 120 concurrent short-chat workers for a 20–30 minute ramp test, but we need 36 hours lead time to carve the pool and provision monitoring hooks. If Samantha confirms Dedicated by end of day Mon Jun 18 we’re good for the Jun 21 slot.

Notes:
- Routing: we’ll route test traffic to a warmed model variant with KV cache enabled to reduce cold-start token costs.
- Observability: enable token-level tracing for the load window; retention on trial is 7 days by default.
- Cost: estimated token spend for the 30m ramp (120 conc, avg 40 tokens per response) ~ 5.76M tokens — see attached plan.

If they choose Hosted: we can run a scaled test (30–40 concurrent) immediately with no provisioning, but metrics will not reflect Dedicated throughput.

Diego
Runtime Product Manager, Redwood Inference

Thanks all — appreciate the clarity. We’ll take Dedicated for a full-fidelity run. Confirming: Wed Jun 21, 09:00–10:30 PT.

I’ll have our engineer (Evan) join; we’ll email a PO to trials@redwood.com by Mon EOD to start the 36-hour carve. Also attaching our high-level token mix for the session.

Looking forward — Sam
